source_ref: XOIM0F deposit (CC0 1.0): row 1 (question text) of the Qualtrics exports fb/high/low/mturk.tab, identical across all four samples. Instrument attribution: Guess & Munger (2023) PSRM 11(1), 110-128 -- the battery is "the 'power user' scale developed by Sundar and Marathe" (Sundar & Marathe 2010, Human Communication Research), 12 statements on a nine-point agree-disagree scale.
note: HOLD, not shipped -- 2026-10-15 silence rule, same as its sibling: the Sundar & Marathe (2010) power user scale is a named third-party instrument and no grant or restriction from the originator could be located (2026-10-17). __items.csv kept in /home/ben/Dropbox/projects/irw/data/itemtext/. What is settled for a later clearance, since this is the resp-axis question the round was asked to decide: the live table stores 1-9 for an administered -4..+4 scale, and 1 = -4 = Strongly Disagree, 5 = 0, 9 = +4 = Strongly Agree. Three independent checks, because a correlation matrix cannot settle global direction (reversing every item leaves every pairwise r unchanged): (i) the administered stem names the scale in presentation order, '-4 = Strongly Disagree to 4 = Strongly Agree', and Qualtrics stores the first presented choice as 1; (ii) the raw marginals are lopsided in the direction only one coding allows -- Q54_1 'I think most technological gadgets are complicated to use' piles up at 1-3 (fb 113/87/65 at 1/2/3 vs 15/22 at 8/9) while Q54_2 'I make good use of most of the features' and Q99_2 'Using any technological device comes easy to me' pile up at 7-9, and the same sample's unambiguous Q53 familiarity items sit at the 'full understanding' end, so the sample is skilled and disagrees that gadgets are complicated; (iii) the authors' own scoring in the deposit's 01a_clean_data.R computes power_mean = (Q54_2 - Q54_1 + Q54_3 + Q54_4 + Q54_5 + Q54_6)/6, subtracting exactly the one reverse-worded item, which only composes correctly if higher = more agreement. option_text therefore carries the administered numeral for each level ('-3', '-2', ... ) with the two labelled end points spelled out, which is what records the 1-9 <-> -4..+4 shift. Q54_1 and Q99_1 are reverse-worded and are stored unreversed in the live table. Gate: validate_items.R --resp-csv PASS, items 12/12, resp 1-9.
